text: Meet Hopboard. A shared clipboard for your nearby devices.
Copy here. Paste there. Same Wi-Fi. No account, cloud, or internet required.
Start session. Add device. Select the host. Enter its six-digit code.
Approve the device. Enable automatic sharing when you're ready.
Copy a link or note on your laptop.
It crosses your local network. Paste it on your other PC.
On Android, keep Hopboard open. Use Paste and Send, or Copy.
Beyond text: Windows development builds also share images.
Send files, folders, or ZIPs. Verified before they are ready to paste.
You choose what shares. Images and files each need separate permission.
Pause from the tray. Reconnect trusted devices. Follow your system theme.
Hopboard. Your devices. One local clipboard.
